build_lexicon_graph: build a graph that transduces letters to word pieces using lexicon_graph
build_token_graph: build a graph with individual token transition models using token_graph
compose_graphs: compose two GTN graphs to compute word decomposition alignments
compute_alignment_graph: compute alignment graph by composing token and decomposition graphs
compute_sequence_loss: compute sequence-level loss using forward_score and intersect on alignment graph
